decision: viewable selection: APSViewer gets a viewableName prop; pickViewable matches 3D geometry nodes by name (exact, then substring) and falls back to getDefaultGeometry; the catalog ranks viewables New Construction > isMasterView > {3D} > first 3D
why: Rooms exist only in the Revit master view; the manifest exposes isMasterView so the rule needs no metadata call (the brief's most-objects rule would need one per viewable)
evidence: components/ui/aps-viewer/aps-viewer.tsx pickViewable; lib/models/catalog.ts VIEWABLE_PREFERENCE; local eval getDocumentNode().name() = New Construction

why: one shape and one rule set shared by route and pages; modifiedAt dropped because OSS listing and details return no date

why: the README roadmap links them and v2 scope is written down instead of remembered

decision: pack is a manifest-driven table: PackManifest.documents one row per measure PDF plus manifest, CSV and elevation PNGs; file names documentFileName(measure, version, ext) = <Measure>_<Title>-<NN>.<ext>; MEASURE_TITLES registry in lib/export/manifest.ts
why: Part 8 versioned naming and the audit-trail cross-reference (parameter, value, unit, file, page) fall out of one table instead of per-measure branches; manifest.parameters carries that shape

decision: CSV is two header-led blocks: design inputs then eight EEM01 rows N..NW with wall_area_m2, glazing_area_m2, wwr_percent to 2 decimals, guide part and page per row; an orientation without a facade writes 0.00 never blank; a run with no EEM01 measure still writes eight zero rows
why: Part 3 says blank orientations fall back to defaults and direct entries are not accepted, so the file mirrors the calculator rows
evidence: lib/export/csv.ts; test EEM01 block has exactly eight orientation rows

decision: PDF via pdf-lib standard Helvetica, A4, entered values on a light yellow fill, title, project, model, URN, viewable, guide part and page, date, author, app version table, one elevation per extra page, disclaimer footer; text outside WinAnsi becomes a question mark
why: standard fonts avoid font embedding in the browser; the auditor rule asks for highlighted entered values and date, title, author on every document

decision: verify: scripts/verify/unit6-pack.mjs built a 12-entry zip (manifest.json, edge-inputs.csv, 8 PDFs, 2 PNGs) in about 300 ms and uploaded it to Blob at packs/verify/run-210king-0001.zip, HEAD 200 with matching content-length
why: script runs under node --import tsx so it imports the TS modules the browser will use; tsx pulled esbuild so pnpm-workspace allowBuilds pins esbuild false

decision: POST /api/export validates x-run-id and x-project against [A-Za-z0-9_-], caps at 25 MB, checks the PK zip magic, puts to packs/<project>/<runId>.zip public with allowOverwrite so re-export of a run replaces the pack
why: the route is a thin boundary; the pack itself is built in the browser
evidence: app/api/export/route.ts typechecks; not exercised against a running server
